name: tembo-video-generator
description: Standalone programmatic video generator for Tembo Page using Remotion (vertical 9:16 format)

scripts.render:all: npm run render:what-is-tembo && npm run render:how-to-builder && npm run render:how-to-ai && npm run render:traffic && npm run render:master-16x9 && npm run render:master-9x16
scripts.render:what-is-tembo: remotion render src/index.tsx what-is-tembo out/what-is-tembo.mp4 --overwrite && cp out/what-is-tembo.mp4 "/Volumes/G-Drive/chroma key pro/tembo-videos/"
scripts.render:how-to-builder: remotion render src/index.tsx how-to-builder out/how-to-builder.mp4 --overwrite && cp out/how-to-builder.mp4 "/Volumes/G-Drive/chroma key pro/tembo-videos/"

scripts.render:traffic: remotion render src/index.tsx traffic-personalization out/traffic-personalization.mp4 --overwrite && cp out/traffic-personalization.mp4 "/Volumes/G-Drive/chroma key pro/tembo-videos/"
scripts.render:master-16x9: remotion render src/index.tsx master-explainer-16x9 out/master-explainer-16x9.mp4 --overwrite && cp out/master-explainer-16x9.mp4 "/Volumes/G-Drive/chroma key pro/tembo-videos/"
